verdict.rationale: Cactus publishes public GitHub repositories (cactus-compute/cactus with engine, bindings and CLI, and cactus-compute/needle with a README), and its pricing docs refer to an "open-source package" for local fine-tuning, so the source is readable. However, no specific license is named anywhere in the evidence, and the "open-source" claim is tied only to the fine-tuning package, so open licensing of the full product is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: named open license (e.g., MIT/Apache) for the engine and Needle repos, confirmation that all components are covered, independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
